commands_used: answer 1. I hunt for a tower marked by the Kings Marker Stone for the Unbound/Never-Writes-Twice affair; a wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth. This is my own errand. Bell Station is the other lead. 2. Get into Fort Chalkmoth keep and see its cellar, here at the fort on Chixathe Mesa. 3. Ask wall captain Sakeeus-Wan for leave to enter, or find another way in unseen; there are also other people here (Theyne Indarys, Tsleel-Vaku) and a guardroom door. 4. I do not know who Sakeeus-Wan, Theyne Indarys or Tsleel-Vaku are, nor the Sarpa Raiders or Jal-Veesa Knot; I can find out by talking to them.

answer 1. Fort Chalkmoth is an old Legion fort held by Archwardens; the captain keeps the keep shut while Sarpa raiders rob chalk carts. I want the cellar for my own errand. 2. Kill the three Sarpa raiders on the western approach, then tell Sakeeus-Wan for a hundred gold and keep access. 3. Fight the raiders, or sneak in via the trapdoor in the yard unseen. 4. I do not know what the Toh-Reel-Ka order prison below the keep holds, or who Theyne Indarys and Tsleel-Vaku are; I can ask them.

answer 1. I killed the raiders; Sakeeus-Wan gave me the keep key and 100 gold. The cellar stair starts in the quartermaster store, and Theyne Indarys keeps its key. 2. Get into the quartermaster store and go down to the cellar, speak to the gaoler Tsleel-Vaku, listen at the cellar door. 3. Pick the store lock, lift Theyne key by pickpocket, or ask Theyne; also try the cellar door directly. Being caught in the store counts as theft. 4. I do not know what moans in the cellar, what the Jar of Hist Sap (Jal-Veesa Knot) is for, or why Tsleel-Vaku is the gaoler; I can find out by looking and asking.
pick Door to Cellar Door win
